title: Maximum Depth of Binary Tree
prompt: Given the root of a binary tree, return its maximum depth. The maximum depth is the number of nodes along the longest path from the root node down to the farthest leaf node.
hints: Recursive: if root is null, return 0. Otherwise return 1 + max(maxDepth(left), maxDepth(right)).
The depth at current node = 1 (for this node) + the max of depths of its subtrees.
DFS or BFS both work. BFS: count levels. DFS: simpler recursion.
